Name: Nature Strikes Back
Author: clumsyjackdaw
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clumsyjackdaw/Branding/main/The_Mod.png[/img]
Every time you hit nature (trees, rocks, etc.) and do damage, they hit back and do damage to you. 
So, be careful what you hit!

When hitting an nature object from the side (left or right), an animation will play showing the object hitting you back. When hitting an object from the top or bottom this animation will not play, since it wil mostly be covered by the object or farmer. 

If the mod is in your mods file it is always running, so be sure to take it out if you do not want to play with it.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clumsyjackdaw/Branding/main/Demo_Video.png[/img]
Short demo video: 
[youtube]3JS79PZMgBQ[/youtube]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clumsyjackdaw/Branding/main/Installation.png[/img]
1. Install SMAPI.
2. ﻿Download the mod.
3. Unzip the mod.
4. Put the unzipped folder in your mods folder.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clumsyjackdaw/Branding/main/Making_Of.png[/img]
